Hi Samantha / Raj —

Thanks again for the 30‑minute discovery today. Quick recap of what I took away:
- Main goals: reduce per‑request latency on customer‑facing endpoints and lower unit cost for embeddings at scale.
- Key constraints: PCI scope for some flows, preferring on‑prem or private VPC for production environments; SLO target ~200ms P50 for snippet generation.
- Stakeholders to include on next call: engineering (CTO/engineering manager) + product (PM).

Next step: propose a 30‑minute product demo (high level + short technical Q&A). Can you let me know which of these windows works for your team (all times PST)?
1) Tue 24 Nov — 9:00–9:30 AM PST
2) Tue 24 Nov — 12:00–12:30 PM PST
3) Wed 25 Nov — 3:30–4:00 PM PST

Please confirm which slot you prefer and who will join from your side (so we can include the right folks from our side — Marissa (SE) and Aditya (AE) will attend).

Attached are the discovery notes I took today. I can tailor the demo to focus more on architecture/latency optimizations or on batch embedding cost controls — let me know your preference.

Thanks,
